title: Shinonome Akito — Thirsting Wanderer〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I told you guys to stop following me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We can't just leave you like this! Don't you realize you've got some kind of amnesia?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember you're VIRTUAL SINGERS. What more do you want? This is none of your business anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nuh-uh! This totally IS our business! We were born from your feel—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Tsk. I can't see a damn thing.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito! Where're you trying to go?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Beats me. That's exactly what I want to know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't know why I'm here, or who I even am. Nothing.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, the wind's really picking up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You two should go hide somewhere. I have to keep walking.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Seriously?! Why are you being so reckless?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just that... I can hear something calling out from inside me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll...lose something precious to me, and myself along with it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why we're here—to support you! So you can keep going!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We want to help all of you make your dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We promised to be there for you no matter what until the very day you surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't worry! We can pull through if we stick together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She's right, Akito! You don't have to face it alone!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I feel like...someone told me that before...)
Please, don't do this to yourself.
There's no way we'll be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND without you!
So if something's bothering you, ask us for help!
Let's sing as a team, Shinonome!
As long as we're together, we'll be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND!
I don't care if you want to try stuff on your own, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yuuuck! My mouse feels all gritty and gross... But!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... We made it out of the sandstorm!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Urgh... My entire body's caked in sand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Rin, Len, I'm sorry for dragging you into this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember that you've always been there to support us. Not to mention how you wouldn't stop pestering me to show you the video of our third event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm really sorry for making you worry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Argh! Quit it! The sand's too hot!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Now we're gonna have to dust off all that sand again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, what did you think would happen if you both body-slammed into me like that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey... Look! There's a flower blooming over there!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're right! In a desert of all places...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speaking of which, isn't this a SEKAI created from a fragment of a feeling? Does that mean that that flower is someone's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A flower that's determined to bloom no matter what. Even in a desert like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Looks like we made it out of that place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's take a quick break at MEIKO's.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Rin, Len, I owe you one for having my back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha, we'd do it again in a heartbeat, so don't sweat it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Buuut if you really insist on repaying us, we wouldn't say no to some yummy cakes or snacks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I like your thinking! If you would, please!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A fragment of a feeling? I'm still struggling to wrap my head around that weird SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But for now, no matter what sandstorms life throws at me, I'll keep going.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As long as I've got them, nothing can hold me back.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito! Are you coming or not?
